properties.description:
The graph's Node editor omits Copy node URL, while the planning path builds that command separately. Consolidate common Node editor command ownership, retaining capability-specific mutation/history controls in their owning host. Verify Graph, planning and type inspection all expose the correct current node URL through one shared implementation.

Completed: before changing behavior, the common NodeEditor fixture recorded {copy:0} against the reviewed expectation {copy:1}. NodeEditor now owns that command and uses the inspected node/type identity. Planning's separate implementation was removed; its comparison view reuses the same command, and unsaved creation drafts omit it. Graph, component type navigation, independent editors and planning current/historical canonical copying are covered. Capability-specific save/delete/history behavior remains in the owning host. The identical unit fixture now records {copy:1}. Original failure log and accepted output: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/2dddb630-5e2e-4d4c-83ed-38a84d43b0db.json. Full build, eight unit checks and 41 focused browser cases passed; live copying returned the selected Graph development task URL.
properties.title: Bug: Graph editor omits shared Node editor commands
